title: SQLi at /api/v1/users
remediation_summary: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements (or the ORM's bound-parameter API) for every query that consumes request input — never string-concatenate request input into SQL. | Validate and canonicalize the input server-side and reject non-conforming values before they reach the data layer. | Run the application's database account with least privilege (no DDL, no access to unrelated schemas).

title: Reverse shell PoC in /upload
remediation_summary: Reject non-image MIME types and run the worker as a non-root user.

title: GitHub PAT leaked in JS bundle
remediation_summary: Suppress or genericize framework banners and X-Powered-By style headers at the reverse proxy.

title: Missing security headers
remediation_summary: Deploy a Content-Security-Policy that pins allowed script/style origins; start in Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, review reports, then enforce. | Add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains once every endpoint is served over HTTPS. | Set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

title: MySQL root password observed in CI script
remediation_summary: Context-encode all untrusted output (HTML/attribute/JS/URL) and prefer framework auto-escaping. | Deploy a Content-Security-Policy that pins allowed script origins as a second line of defense.
